newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BOLSWESSANEN SETS THAI JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: BOLSWESSANEN SETS THAI JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Dutch food and drinks group BolsWessanen NV said on Monday it had agreed to set up a joint venture with Golden Poultry International Ltd of Bangkok, Thailand.

BolsWessanen said it would take a controlling interest and would be the managing partner of the joint venture which will be called Golden Foods International Ltd and will generate annual sales of some $100 million.
The Dutch company said its Thai partner was a fully integrated producer of poultry products and would transfer its four poultry-processing units to the joint venture.
The joint venture will be neutral to BolsWessanen's earnings per share in 1997 but will make a positive contribution to earnings per share from 1998, it added.
BolsWessanen said the deal marked a first step in its strategy of developing the Far East as a third major region for its business activities alongside Europe and the United States.
